name: Amethyst Equipment
description: Adds an amethyst ingot (smelted from amethyst shards and found in abandoned mineshafts), a full amethyst tool set, a sword, a spear and a set of armour. The armour, sword and spear grow stronger with the light level the player stands in: armour gains 0.8 armour and 0.2 knockback resistance per light level on top of the golden armour values, and the weapons deal 6 base attack damage plus 0.3 per light level. Every item has 9/10 of the netherite durability.
